在 ComfyUI 中使用 Flux 模型进行绘制

外画（Outpainting）是一种有趣的技术，可以将图像延伸到其原始边界之外，已在摄影师、数字艺术家和内容创作者中流行起来。无论您是想无缝扩展背景还是向图像添加缺失的细节，生成式 AI 工具都可以创造奇迹。我们从两个方面来探讨一下：通量模型和生成填充.

1. 外涂的通量模型

Flux 模型是强大的生成神经网络，可以创建高质量的图像内容。特别是，SDXL（稳定扩散 XL）检查点通常用于初始外绘制。以下是使用 Flux 模型进行绘制的分步工作流程舒适用户界面:

  1. 设置外涂区域:

    • 首先上传您想要替换的图像。

    • 将图像放在黑色背景上。黑色区域代表将被涂掉的空间。

    • 使用“ImageBlend”节点将上传的图像叠加到黑色背景上。根据需要调整大小和位置。

    • 使用“SDXL Empty Latent Size Picker”节点设置分辨率。确保它与 SDXL 尺寸相匹配，以避免外漆中出现额外的手或脚等问题。

    • 在继续之前预览您的更改以可视化调整1.

  2. 使用 SDXL 进行初始绘制:

    • 应用 SDXL 检查点进行第一轮外绘制。在此阶段，使用 Flux 模型直接进行外涂效果较差。

  3. 恢复原始细节:

    • 使用另一个节点组恢复在 SDXL 绘制期间更改的任何细节。

  4. 使用 Flux 模型重新绘制:

    • 该小组利用 Flux 模型重新绘制 SDXL 填充区域并修复任何问题（例如奇怪的过渡）。

  5. 放大最终图像:

    • 确保未绘制的图像具有高质量并可供输出。

2. 生成填充人工智能工具

生成填充 AI 工具可让您创造性地扩展图像。以下是一些选项：

  • AI外画:

    • 上传您的图像并使用上下文感知人工智能对其进行扩展。该工具分析图像的上下文并在扩展过程中保持一致的风格。您甚至可以提高图像分辨率2.

  • AI 画布格蒂姆格.ai:

    • 从可以自由修改的构建块（框架）创建完整图像。 AI Canvas 支持外绘、修复和生成。它用户友好但功能强大3.

  • Kapwing 的图像扩展器:

    • 让 AI 处理细节并生成上下文以在调整图像大小时填充新的空白区域4.

请记住，这些工具就像数字艺术家调色板中的神奇画笔。随意尝试和创造！如果您想要更详细的教程或有具体问题，请告诉我。 😊🎨

Outpainting with Flux Models in ComfyUI

Outpainting—an intriguing technique that extends an image beyond its original boundaries—has gained popularity among photographers, digital artists, and content creators. Whether you want to seamlessly expand backgrounds or add missing details to your images, generative AI tools can work wonders. Let’s explore two aspects:Flux modelsandgenerative fill.

1. Flux Models for Outpainting

Flux models are powerful generative neural networks that can create high-quality image content. In particular, theSDXL(Stable Diffusion XL) checkpoint is commonly used for initial outpainting. Here’s a step-by-step workflow for outpainting using Flux models inComfyUI:

  1. Setting Up the Area for Outpainting:

    • Begin by uploading the image you want to outpaint.

    • Place the image on a black background. The black area represents the space that will be outpainted.

    • Use the “ImageBlend” node to overlay the uploaded image onto the black background. Adjust the size and position as needed.

    • Set the resolution using the “SDXL Empty Latent Size Picker” node. Make sure it matches SDXL dimensions to avoid issues like extra hands or feet in the outpainting.

    • Preview your changes to visualize adjustments before proceeding1.

  2. Initial Outpainting with SDXL:

    • Apply the SDXL checkpoint for the first round of outpainting. Direct outpainting with the Flux model is less effective at this stage.

  3. Restoring Original Details:

    • Use another node group to restore any details altered during the SDXL outpainting.

  4. Repainting with Flux Model:

    • This group leverages the Flux model to repaint the SDXL-filled areas and fix any issues (e.g., weird transitions).

  5. Upscaling the Final Image:

    • Ensure the outpainted image is high-quality and ready for output.

2. Generative Fill AI Tools

Generative fill AI tools allow you to extend images creatively. Here are a few options:

  • AI Outpainting:

    • Upload your image and extend it using context-aware AI. The tool analyzes your image’s context and maintains consistent style during expansion.You can even increase image resolution2.

  • AI Canvas bygetimg.ai:

    • Create full images from building blocks (frames) that you can modify freely. AI Canvas supports outpainting, inpainting, and generation.It’s user-friendly yet powerful3.

  • Kapwing’s Image Extender:

    • Let AI handle the details and generate context to fill in new blank space when resizing images4.

Remember, these tools are like magical brushes in a digital artist’s palette. Feel free to experiment and create! If you’d like more detailed tutorials or have specific questions, just let me know. 😊🎨
